ICAR NBSSLUP Young Professional I Recruitment 2026 - Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ICAR NBSSLUP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Young Professional-I post is scheduled for 12 August 2026. Candidates should report at the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Young Professional-I post?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess a Post-Graduate degree in Geography/ RS & GIS/ Geo-informatics or a Post-Graduate degree in Agricultural and Allied Sciences/ Geology/ Computer Science with a PG Diploma in Remote Sensing and GIS/ Geoinformatics, along with 2 years of experience in Remote Sensing & GIS.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Young Professional-I position?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 22 years, and the maximum age limit is 45 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional-I post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 30,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Young Professional-I post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Young Professional-I post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at ICAR National Bureau of Soil Survey and Land Use Planning, Kolkata, West Bengal, 700091.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates (if applicable), along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on an Interview.
